description: This file defines an abstract base class `CustomPlacementBaseGrain` implementing a grain interface with a method `GetRuntimeInstanceId`. It also defines three concrete grain classes with custom placement strategies using attributes, each extending the base grain class.

classes.name: CustomPlacementBaseGrain
classes.description: Abstract base class for custom placement test grains, providing a method to get runtime instance ID.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime identity as a task result.

classes.name: CustomPlacement_FixedSiloGrain
classes.description: Concrete grain class with a fixed silo placement strategy, extending the base grain.

classes.name: CustomPlacement_ExcludeOneGrain
classes.description: Concrete grain class with an exclude one silo placement strategy, extending the base grain.

classes.name: CustomPlacement_RequestContextBased
classes.description: Concrete grain class with a request context based placement strategy, extending the base grain.
